newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TELIA TO LAY SWEDEN/LITHUANIA PHONE CABLE.
newsitem.headline: TELIA TO LAY SWEDEN/LITHUANIA PHONE CABLE.

text.p: Swedish telephone group Telia said on Friday it is to lay a submarine cable between Sweden and Lithuania to become operational in autumn of this year.

"The cable, which will be operational this autumn, will terminate on the Swedish island of Gotland and in Sventoji, Lithuania from which the link will continue overland to Klaipeda," Telia said in a statement.
The group said that its Lithuanian subsidiary, Lietelija, has also been awarded a licence by the communications ministry to provide data and information services.

"I am very satisfied with the positive approach of the Lithuanian ministry of communications to our company and to Telia during the preparatory discussions which led to the issuance of the licence," Lietelija head Per Wanneberg said in a statement.
It said that a contract to supply the cabling had already been signed with DSC Communications of Denmark and Ericsson Cables of Sweden.
